name: Town Square
desc1: As can be seen from the masses of townsfolk gathered around the make-
desc2: shift stalls and shops here, this is the centre of Silvermere. Despite
desc3: the recent increase in highway ambushes, fresh vegetables and meats
desc4: are still brought in by brave farmers, and these are on prominent
desc5: display. You can see a great many trinkets for sale as well, such as
desc6: intricate wooden puppets, to bolts of beautiful cloth. Streets lead
desc7: off in all directions, and a manhole can be seen under some debris.
